trace.question: Which bond type accounted for the majority of the bonds found in molecule TR010 and state whether or not this molecule is carcinogenic?
trace.evidence: TR010 is the molecule id; majority of the bond found refers to MAX(COUNT(bond_type));

attempts.sql:
SELECT b.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type IS NOT NULL
  AND b.bond_type <> ''
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

verdicts.text:
